name: cast0: Turn Text into a Published Podcast
description: Send text, get a podcast episode. cast0 converts it to audio using TTS (text-to-podcast), publishes it to an automatically hosted RSS feed, and delivers it to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Overcast, or any podcast app. Subscribe once, episodes arrive automatically.

apiKey.description: Your cast0 API key (starts with pk_). Get it from cast0.ai.
